meta.title: Activity of deputies
meta.note: Roll-call votes of the Sejm, terms 3 to 10 (1997 onward), from the Sejm's own API, computed by the Legislative activity project. Share cast is the share of roll calls held during the mandate on which the deputy voted for, against or abstained. A rebellion is a vote against the deputy's club's line (the plurality of its members' votes; ties and votes while unaffiliated left out). Statements are floor speeches and questions are interpellations and written questions signed first; both are blank where the term has no such data (statements from term 6, questions from term 7).
